title: Singapore: the contribution rates of the Central Provident Fund for employers and employees aged 35 and below, July 1955 to January 2026
source: Central Provident Fund Board, dataset 'CPF contribution rates' (d_98ffa142ae0dec40391f78f81d26aca9) on data.gov.sg
series: effective_from (month the rates took effect, YYYY-MM), age_grp ('35 years & below' only), contributing_party (Employer, Employee), contribution_rate (per cent of wage, as the dataset prints it)

The book's notice (in the bibliography, the case box and the caption of fig:eastasia_cpf): Contains information from CPF contribution rates accessed on 12 November 2026 from data.gov.sg which is made available under the terms of the Singapore Open Data Licence version 1.0 https://data.gov.sg/open-data-licence (rows sl_use, sl_attribution, sl_official of eastasia_facts).
citation: Central Provident Fund Board, 'CPF contribution rates', data.gov.sg (bibitem cpf2026)
notes: Read from the dataset's API on data.gov.sg: https://data.gov.sg/api/action/datastore_search?resource_id=d_98ffa142ae0dec40391f78f81d26aca9&limit=1000 (SHA-256 fafde4b300e1a4f85c2b01ebdac10fbb6197e80b2f4907369549738673b2f5f4), 682 rows for all age groups, of which the rows of the age group '35 years & below' are kept; its metadata https://api-production.data.gov.sg/v2/public/api/datasets/d_98ffa142ae0dec40391f78f81d26aca9/metadata (SHA-256 26daef4b772c35797bb6148e33bcacfbf2494df087c419644e9e97d62821540b) names the Central Provident Fund Board as the agency that manages it, gives the coverage as 1955-07-01 to 2026-01-31 and describes the rates: 'As a proportion of wage, for private sector employees and public sector non-pensionable employees.' and 'The CPF contribution rates are applicable for the highest wage band.' It also says 'Percentages are expressed as a number out of 1.', while the column prints per cent (5 for 5 per cent): the book reads the column as per cent, which agrees with Young (1992, p. 22). Both files were downloaded on 2026-11-12; the dataset is updated by the agency, so a later download may differ.
